title: ICLayout-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Custom Circuit Layout Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.12982v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are being explored for circuit design, but their ability to produce high-quality custom layouts has not been extensively evaluated. ICLayout-Bench is a benchmark in which agents use electronic design automation (EDA) tools to construct and optimize GDSII layouts from transistor-level circuit netlists. These layouts are evaluated using physical verification, parasitic extraction, and post-layout simulation. Layouts that pass the physical and functional checks are scored on electrical performance and area. The benchmark includes 165 tasks across 13 process design kits (PDKs), covering technology nodes from 3 nm to 180 nm. The tasks span analog, mixed-signal, and digital circuits in open-source and commercial EDA flows. The experiments evaluate 22 configurations spanning seven models on 21 public and 19 private tasks. translated_title: ICLayout-Bench：面向定制电路版图设计的LLM智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正在被探索应用于电路设计，但其生成高质量定制版图的能力尚未得到广泛评估。ICLayout-Bench是一个基准测试，其中智能体使用电子设计自动化（EDA）工具从晶体管级电路网表构建和优化GDSII版图。这些版图通过物理验证、寄生参数提取和后版图仿真进行评估。通过物理和功能检查的版图将依据电气性能和面积进行评分。该基准测试包含165个任务，涵盖13个工艺设计套件（PDK），工艺节点范围从3纳米到180纳米。任务覆盖开源和商业EDA流程中的模拟、混合信号和数字电路。实验评估了7个模型在21个公开任务和19个私有任务上的22种配置。公开任务上的平均版图得分范围为4.22至80.26，私有任务上为1.43至67.01。
tldr: 该论文提出了ICLayout-Bench基准测试，首次系统性评估LLM智能体使用EDA工具从晶体管级网表生成高质量集成电路版图的能力，涵盖165个任务、13个PDK以及3nm至180nm的工艺节点。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ICLayout-Bench, a benchmark that systematically evaluates LLM agents' ability to use EDA tools to generate high-quality IC layouts from transistor-level netlists, spanning 165 tasks, 13 PDKs, and technology nodes from 3nm to 180nm.
